name: github-readme-viewer
description: View README.md files like on GitHub with dark/light mode toggle.

github-readme-viewer.autoOpen.description: Automatically open preview when a markdown file is opened

github-readme-viewer.updateDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before updating preview after editing (0 = instant update)

github-readme-viewer.protectPreviewColum.description: Protect the preview column from other files. When enabled, the preview uses a dedicated column and other files opened in that column will be moved to the first column.

github-readme-viewer.openInBrowser.description: Open preview in external browser instead of VS Code webview panel. The preview will update automatically as you edit the file.

github-readme-viewer.maxWidth.description: Maximum width of the content in the preview (in pixels). Use 'auto' for full width. Default GitHub width is 980px.
github-readme-viewer.maxWidth.markdownDescription: Maximum width of the content in the preview (in pixels). Use `auto` for full width. **Default GitHub width is 980px.**

github-readme-viewer.enableEmoji.description: Enable emoji rendering (e.g., :smile:, :heart:). Applies to both IDE and browser previews.

github-readme-viewer.enableBreaks.description: Convert single line breaks to HTML line breaks (similar to GitHub behavior). Applies to both IDE and browser previews.

github-readme-viewer.closeOnFileClose.description: Automatically close preview when the markdown file is closed (IDE preview only).

github-readme-viewer.focusEditorAfterOpe.description: Focus the editor after opening the preview, allowing you to continue editing (IDE preview only).

github-readme-viewer.openPreviewKeybindi.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the preview. Default is 'alt+r' (or 'Opt+R' on Mac). To customize, go to File > Preferences > Keyboard Shortcuts and search for 'Open README Preview'. Note: This setting is informational only - you must configure the keybinding manually in VS Code settings.
github-readme-viewer.openPreviewKeybindi.markdownDescription: Keyboard shortcut to open the preview. Default is `alt+r`. **To customize:** Go to `File > Preferences > Keyboard Shortcuts` (or `Ctrl+K Ctrl+S`) and search for `Open README Preview` to change the keybinding. This setting is informational only.

scripts.compile-web: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package-web: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
